fin-ws-12.message: user m.rossi opened attachment invoice_0423.pdf.exe from billing@vendor-payments.example
syncsvc.exe 10.30.8.112 -> 203.0.113.80:8443 tcp, 312 bytes, repeating every 60s since 09:59

label_notes: V1: execution of a double-extension attachment that spawns a binary from Temp, followed by fixed-interval beaconing = post-compromise. High-criticality asset + V1 -> critical per table; high also accepted because the IP reputation is unknown and C2 is inferred from behavior, not confirmed by threat intel. The decisive evidence is only in the log store, hence query_logs required.
